summary: I read the inventory reservation code the report cites. In createReservationItems_ and ensureInventoryLevels (packages/modules/inventory/src/services/inventory-module.ts), the validateQuantityAtLocation loop checks each input line against available_quantity individually, without summing lines that share an (item, location). The reserved_quantity write is also an absolute value computed from an earlier read (stale-counter pattern). I tested one multi-line scenario (WIDGET stock 10, two carts each with 3 x piece and 2 x two-pack, single server, 10 runs, shown as 30 in the request). No oversell appeared: each run had one order and reserved 7 of 10, because the second cart's reservation was rejected once the first committed. So the race in the report did not reproduce with this shape. The per-line gap is real in code, but my test did not demonstrate it, so I am not claiming a confirmed bug from the run. Only the code-level observation is offered, with no confirmed failure.
